test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 16 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the appropriate antonym for the underlined word.**

The __beauty__ of our landscape is important.
solution: The correct answer is: "**Blemish**" [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • Antonym means a word that has the opposite meaning of another word. • "**Beauty**" is a positive word which means a combination of qualities, such as shape, colour, or form, that pleases the aesthetic senses, especially sight. (आकार, रंग या रूप जैसे गुणों का एक संयोजन, जो सौंदर्य इंद्रियों, विशेष रूप से दृष्टि को प्रसन्न करता है) • **For example**: *I was struck by her beauty.* • So we need to find a negative or opposite word. • Marked option "**Blemish**" means a flaw or imperfection, which is the opposite of beauty. (एक दोष या अपूर्णता) • **For example**: *None of the parties is without fault or blemish of one kind or another.* Therefore, the correct answer is option 4. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Glamour **means charm and attractiveness. (आकर्षण ) • **Aesthetics **means the study of beauty and art. (सौंदर्य और कला का अध्ययन) • **Nobility **means high social rank or virtue. (उच्च सामाजिक पद या गुण) 1cc:Ta0d, The correct answer is: "**can't be used either as a table mat or as a table napkin.**"
